tha.p: Tha alphabet which is 25th consonant in 41 alphabets and in 33 consonants, in 17 Vagga  it is 5 Vagga (dantaja)ta-vagga, (nissita)- consonant which depends on the second vowel. See original. Compare with Tipi,9,702+703+704+705+706 tha tha(ti) [ṭhā+kvi. Thī(dhāna, ṭī. 230-1)]. (1) Dhamma which is the cause of prosper and wealth = Maṅgalā (Blessing). (2) Protect from danger. (3) Mountain named Tha. See original.

thā：ထာ
ဘူ = ဂတိနိဝတ္တိယံ-သွားခြင်းမှ ဆုတ်နစ်ခြင်း ရပ်ခြင်း၌။ သဒ္ဒသံဟတေသု-အသံပြုခြင်း，စိတ်တွန့် ဆုတ်ခြင်းတို့၌။ မောဂ်နိ-၂၊ နှာ-၂၆၄။ ထာတိ။
DOP: 1 tha [ ts ], the sound ‘th’ , the consonant ‘th’; Sadd 553, 29 (thassa ṭhattaṃ); 606, 1 (ta tha da dha na); — °- kāra , m. , 1. the letter or sound ‘th’; Sp 1400, 2 (suṇātu me ti vattabbe takārassa ~aṃ katvā suṇāthu me ti vacanaṃ sithilassa dhanitakaraṇaṃ nāma); It-a I 35, 30 (atthuppatti eva aṭṭhuppatti ~assa ṭhakāraṃ katvā, Be Se so; Ce, Ee omit ~assa ṭhakāraṃ katva); — 2. the sound tha; Vv-a 79, 5 (pañcarathāsatā ti gāthāsukhatthaṃ ~assa dīghaṃ liṅgavipallāsaṃ ca katvā vuttaṃ).

ṭha m. [ ts ], the sound ‘ṭh’; the consonant ‘ṭh’; Sadd 553, 29 (thassa ṭhattaṃ); 604, 20 (ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa); 605, 31 ; — °- kāra , m. , the letter or sound ‘ṭh’; It-a I 35, 30 (atthuppatti eva aṭṭhupatti thakārassa ~aṃ katvā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee omit thakārassa ~aṃ katvā).

ṭha.p: Ṭha ṭha- letter; Among the fourty one  letters (Byaññaḥ), it is  the second syllable  (muddhaja) ṭa vaga  .Tipi,8,685 ṭha ṭha(pu) [ṭhā+a]  (1) Loud voice. (2) Mahessara deity,   mahādeva deity. (3) The full moon.(Ti) (4) who is cease to exist (or) who is extinct;  he.
a: ဌ ဌ-အက္ခရာ၊ ၎၁-လုံးသော အက္ခရာတို့တွင်-ဗျည်း-လျှာထိပ်၌ဖြစ်သော(မုဒ္ဓဇ)ဋ ဝဂ် ဒုတိယ-အက္ခရာ။ တိပိ၊၈၊၆၈၅ ṭha ဌ(ပု) [ဌာ+အ] (၁)ကြီးသောအသံ။(၂)မဟေဿရနတ်၊ မဟာဒေဝနတ်။(၃)လဝန်း။(တိ)(၎)ဆိတ်သုဉ်းသော၊ သူ။
